summary: Interpreted the repeat of the fixed verify experiment: receipt 107a6d6c816d448da2b7ff6e3145bac1 reproduces receipt b02d5ff23a504a8ea38116085ba8e23c on all three partitions — the non-voter-only partition again returned success in 0ms with the leader still in Leader state and a quorum of 2 over three voters (index 1), the voter-only control again succeeded (index 3), and the no-peer control again failed with 'leadership lost while committing log' at 208ms against 202ms in the first run (index 5). The account's executions map now cites both receipts and the 'repeatability not established' limitation is replaced by what the two runs jointly show, including the 6ms schedule-dependent spread in the step-down control; a repeat supports reproducibility under the exercised conditions, not schedule independence. No execution was requested. Two further source reads found nothing to register: runSnapshots drains userSnapshotCh, and takeSnapshot rejects a snapshot whose applied index lags committedIndex, so the user-triggered snapshot path carries the same guard as the threshold-driven one.
